Southeastern Kentucky Association of Native People

The Southeastern Kentucky Association of Native People organizes the Honoring Our Veterans Pow Wow in the Corbin area. WYMT’s coverage describes how the event celebrates Native heritage and honors veterans.

Where to start

The association’s 2026 vendor packet names the organization and gives the Corbin venue. WYMT covered the 2024 powwow and spoke with an organizer about passing on cultural knowledge to young people.

Honoring Our Veterans Pow Wow pavilion near Corbin
Aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (2022), via USFS and GeoPlatform

Source & image record ↗ · Public domain · USDA aerial photography

The Southeastern Kentucky Association of Native People’s vendor packet identifies this pavilion as the site of its Honoring Our Veterans Pow Wow. The USDA aerial photograph shows the event venue near Corbin, Kentucky. The image is resized for the web.
